title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a solar bump to the daily demand curve
body:
## Problem
Session 1 shows a demand curve with no solar generation, so there is no midday dip and no steep evening ramp.

## Context
The solar dip (the duck curve) is the reason inertia and fast ramping matter more every year.

## Expected outcome
A `solar_curve(hour)` function and a figure showing demand minus solar.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Function importable and tested in the checkpoint
- [ ] A new figure with labelled axes and units

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: synthetic inertia from a battery
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`, Session 4. Students ask how a battery can replace the inertia of a retired power station.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the roadmap checkpoint is met
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a governor headroom limit to the frequency model
body:
## Problem
The shipped governor can add any amount of power, which hides the importance of spinning reserve.

## Context
Roadmap Session 5. The settled frequency with limited headroom is lower than the droop formula.

## Expected outcome
A headroom option in `simulate_frequency` and a figure comparing it with the unlimited governor.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Settled frequency matches the hand formula with the headroom limit
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a multi-generator grid with a power-factor panel
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows several generators, a load, a frequency trace and a power triangle; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Frequency trace with nadir and settled value that match hand formulas
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
